model.contrast: Exact frozen-model coordinate reset over 11 independent controls; not SHAP or identified causality
model.model_name: AGORA final Temporal GNN v15, frozen 90/180 output selection
model.run_id_namespace: Original training IDs; final_dataset_run_id is explicitly separate

uncertainty_calibration.reason: No calibrated predictive interval is bundled; no confidence percentage is inferred

hold_action_calibration.residual_definition: native future interval truth minus frozen prediction
hold_action_calibration.aggregation: Native numerator/denominator sums; event counts summed; invalid loss ratios masked
hold_action_calibration.dependence: Three origins from each run are correlated; 540 cases are not 540 independent simulation seeds
hold_action_calibration.intended_use: Descriptive baseline forecast error reference; not a calibrated safety bound for candidate switches
hold_action_calibration.future_observations: Read only by offline calibrate_validation.py, never passed to inference or candidate ranking

model.counter_semantics: ho_attempts, pingpongs and rlfs are interval event counts; other targets are native interval means/ratios
model.parameter_policy: Reject outside the observed envelope; flag in-envelope non-grid values as unvalidated interpolation
limitations: Fixed-run same-clock replay training does not identify online switched-action causal effects
